warning.title: Uracyahari?
warning.body: Kubera ibanga ry'abarwayi, ecran yawe irafunga mu masegonda {{seconds}}.

stepUp.title: Emeza ko ari wowe
stepUp.description: Iki gikorwa gisaba ijambo ry'ibanga na kode iva muri porogaramu yawe y'umutekano.
stepUp.codeHint: Imibare 6 iva muri porogaramu yawe y'umutekano

security.title: Umutekano
security.pinIsSet: Ufite PIN. Yikoreshe ufungure ecran vuba.
security.pinNotSet: Shyiraho PIN y'imibare 4 kugeza kuri 6 kugira ngo ufungure ecran vuba. Ijambo ry'ibanga rihora rikora.
security.pinHint: Imibare 4 kugeza kuri 6. Irinde imibare isubiramo cyangwa ikurikiranye nka 1234.
security.lockBody: Ecran yawe irafunga nyuma y'iminota {{minutes}} udakoresha. Yifunge ubwawe igihe ugiye.
